description: HushPinterest v0.0.3, the first release: 17 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0, and the same set for 14.25.0 on Android 9. Hides promoted pins, with optional switches for AI-labeled and shopping pins, plus pin downloads and privacy controls. Validation: 640 runtime tests passed. All 146 patch tests passed. All 17 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.38.0 and 14.25.0. Needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.
